newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Two favorites hit actives lists.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Two favorites hit actives lists.

text.p: Two old options favorites, Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) and Micron Technology, returned to the list of most active issues on Monday, traders said.
"It looks like old timers' day," said Michael Schwartz, a managing director at Oppenheimer & Co, referring to Telmex and Micron.

The Telmex November 35 call options topped the call actives list on both the American Stock Exchange and the Chicago Board Options Exchange. Telmex options trade on four of the five U.S. options exchanges.
Telmex shares were up 7/16 at 32-1/2 in afternoon trading.
Schwartz said the activity in the Telmex November 35 calls was probably from one investor splitting the business between the two exchanges.
On the CBOE, the Telmex November 35 call traded more than 6,800 contracts. On the AMEX, it traded more than 8,700.
Traders said the particular strategy was unclear, with few other Telmex options doing much business.
For Micron Technology options, which trade on the CBOE and the Pacific Stock Exchange, the September 25 call was a big winner as the stock rallied sharply.
"It looks like a resurgence in high-tech stocks," Schwartz said.
Another active technology issue was America Online Inc, which began trading on the New York Stock Exchange on Monday after being listed on the Nasdaq market.
America Online shares were up 2-1/8 at 29-1/8.
The America Online October 25 put traded 4,230 contracts on the Pacific Stock Exchange. It was off 1/2 at 7/8.
In addition to the Pacific Stock Exchange, the options trade on the American Stock Exchange and CBOE. --G.Crawford, (312) 408-8750/E-mail: derivatives@reuters.com
